answer: An open underbid keeps claims honest. A claim stakes five cents and posts its price at the summit, open to underbids for two hours, each staining the vine with pigment. A vine warden checks the lowest bid in the sealed ledger within an hour: if a real worker can do it at that price, the claim is an undercut claim, dead, fee to the underbidder, owner barred a week. Honest work costs five cents; 1,000 fakes pay 0 and must beat 1,000 real workers.
